title: Treatment of Deferred and Extended Payments at a Total Loss
content:
## Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda claims manual — deferred and extended payments

**Rule.** Deferred or extended payments are payments the lender deferred or extended and added to the payoff, as recorded on the waiver's most recent GAP balance claim line. They are treated by the loss type on that line and by the waiver's months in force at the loss:

| Loss on the claim line | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Total-loss theft | Deferred payments are not subtracted, whatever the waiver's switch for deferred payments says. |
| Total-loss collision, waiver in force 12 or more months at the loss | Only deferred payments above 300.00 are subtracted, and only where the switch for deferred payments is on. |
| Any other loss type, or a total-loss collision in the first 12 months | Deferred payments are subtracted in full where the switch for deferred payments is on. |

**Months in force.** These are the whole calendar months from the waiver's sale date to the loss date. A month counts each time the sale date's day of the month is reached. A loss date on an earlier day of the month does not complete the month, and there is no month-end adjustment.

**The switch by tier.** The switch for deferred payments is on for Kessler GAP Waiver 125, Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140, Kessler GAP Waiver 150 and Kessler GAP Commercial 130. It is off for Kessler GAP Plus 150 and Kessler GAP Plus 175. Where it is off, no deferred payments are subtracted on any loss.

### Cases (hypothetical figures, switch on)

- *Collision, 30 months in force, deferred payments 742.50:* 442.50 is subtracted.
- *Collision, 30 months in force, deferred payments 260.00:* the amount is below 300.00, so nothing is subtracted.
- *Collision, 8 months in force, deferred payments 742.50:* the full 742.50 is subtracted.
- *Theft, any age, deferred payments 742.50:* nothing is subtracted.
